description.value:
A shimmering sphere of energy forms around a Large or smaller creature or object within range. An unwilling creature may avoid it with a successful Dexterity saving throw; otherwise it is trapped inside for the duration.

Nothing—matter, energy, or other power effects—crosses the barrier in either direction, though the occupant can still breathe. The sphere itself is immune to damage, and neither the interior nor exterior can harm the other across it.

Weightless and form-fitting, the sphere can be rolled by its occupant (using an action to push against the walls, at up to half its speed) or moved by others from outside. A disintegrate power aimed at the sphere destroys it without harming what's inside.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
